name: circuitous_route_gate_and_basic_enter_tapped
note: Circuitous Route: 'Search your library for up to two basic land cards and/or Gate cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.' P0's library holds a Forest, a Plains (basic), an Azorius Guildgate (a Gate), an Evolving Wilds (neither) and a creature card. P0 finds the Guildgate and the Forest: both enter the battlefield tapped under P0's control; the Plains, the Wilds and the creature stay in the library.
